people.name: Rome
people.line: Capital city of the Roman Empire

translations.web: When the centurion heard it, he went to the commanding officer and told him, “Watch what you are about to do, for this man is a Roman!”
translations.bsb: On hearing this, the centurion went and reported it to the commander. “What are you going to do?” he said. “This man is a Roman citizen.”
translations.kjv: When the centurion heard that, he went and told the chief captain, saying, Take heed what thou doest: for this man is a Roman.
translations.asv: And when the centurion heard it, he went to the chief captain and told him, saying, What art thou about to do? for this man is a Roman.
